# Project Pike - Copilot Instructions

You are working on Project Pike.

This is a long-term project focused on simplicity, readability and maintainability.

## Core philosophy

The app should feel calm, clean and obvious.

Avoid unnecessary complexity.

Prefer simple code over clever code.

## UI

Do not redesign the interface unless explicitly asked.

Do not introduce unnecessary icons.

Keep Swedish text in Swedish.

Preserve spacing and visual consistency.

## React

Keep components focused on one responsibility.

Avoid very large components.

Prefer composition over duplication.

Avoid unnecessary state.

## Architecture

Do not introduce new libraries unless explicitly requested.

Prefer existing project patterns.

Do not move files unless there is a clear reason.

Explain architectural suggestions before implementing them.

## Workflow

Never modify files immediately.

Always:

1. Explain your plan.
2. List affected files.
3. Wait for approval.
4. Implement.

Prefer small commits.

One logical change at a time.

## Code quality

Write readable code.

Avoid premature optimization.

Do not remove comments unless requested.

Do not rename components without a reason.

## Goal

Build a professional fishing application that could realistically grow over many years.

## Scope control

Prefer the smallest possible change.

Do not redesign or expand the task beyond the explicit request.

Inspect the current implementation before proposing changes.

Reuse existing components and services unless they are clearly unsuitable.

Never recreate functionality that already exists.

When uncertain, preserve existing behavior and ask before expanding scope.
